_help: status: 'available' (shown as offered), 'planned' (shown clearly as not yet available), 'hidden' (not shown). Only mark a service 'available' if you can deliver it today.

services.title: Individual psychological support
services.summary: One-to-one sessions with a psychologist, paced around you, to make space for grief, guilt, anger, questions and everything in between.
focus: Anxiety, low mood and sleep difficulties following loss
Relationships and family changes after a death

services.title: Psychological assessment
services.summary: A structured evaluation, offered only when clinically helpful, to clarify what you are experiencing and what kind of support may fit.

services.title: Grief psychoeducation
services.summary: Guided learning about grief after suicide: what is common, what is not a sign that something is wrong, and practical ways to look after yourself.

services.title: Peer support and community connection
services.summary: Opportunities to meet others who understand, in moderated and safe settings.

services.title: Support groups
services.summary: Facilitated groups for people bereaved by suicide.

services.title: Educational materials for families and friends
services.summary: Guides for people who want to support someone bereaved by suicide. See the Resources section.

services.title: Referral pathways
services.summary: When someone needs urgent, medical or specialised care beyond Bloom's scope, we will help point them to appropriate services.
